Gold City and I have just completed
today's
training. However...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is it okay if I stay and train a bit
more?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
My modeling gig for tomorrow morning
got
canceled.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So I want to use this time to train as
much as I
can. You don't mind, right?

text_block_list.text:
I have to use my time wisely so that
others won't
think running is just my side
hustle.

Brimming with motivation, Gold City
continues
her training until it's almost
curfew.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You could let me overdo it a little bit!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...No, you're right. I just said it
myself—"overdo
it." I understand. I'll get
some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'll go back to my room and see
what
international celebrities are talking
about on
Umastagram.
